**Connect each client's tools once, and never switch again.** Version {{VERSION}}.

## Download

| Your computer | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `Ringkeeper-Connect-Setup-{{VERSION}}.exe` |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 and later) | `Ringkeeper-Connect-{{VERSION}}-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac with Intel | `Ringkeeper-Connect-{{VERSION}}-x64.dmg` |

(The `.zip`, `.yml` and `.blockmap` files are for automatic updates; you don't need them.)

## If this release isn't signed

- **Windows** shows "Windows protected your PC" when you open the installer. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **Mac** says the app can't be checked for malicious software. Open **System Settings > Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway** next to Ringkeeper Connect. Unsigned Mac copies also can't update themselves, so download new versions from this page.

## After installing

Ringkeeper Connect finds Claude Desktop, Cursor and Claude Code and offers to bring in the connections already set up in them. Click **Connect apps**, then restart Claude Desktop. It backs up your apps' settings first; **Restore original settings** in the app, or uninstalling, puts them back.

Need help setting it up for your clients? <https://yushkin.us> or [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexey-yushkin).
